bio:
Quantum Vibes is an interactive quantum mechanics simulator. Run the double-slit experiment and watch the interference pattern build one particle at a time, then switch to Feynman path integrals and see the sum over histories that produces it.

One page, no install. By Tront (Trent Sterling).
title: Quantum Vibes by Tront
list:
• VibePrime: Educational prime number search and sieve visualiser.
  • VibeSpace: Three.js particle space simulation.
  • VibeStar: A* pathfinding visualiser with web workers and a lot of knobs.
